Ember · team of one with AI assistance. Download the data (data dictionary, ledger claims). Ember explorer. Built from NASA PSI records, NASA technical reports and a reproducible pipeline. The page generates no text: what it shows is quoted from NASA records, counted from the data, or taken from the claim ledger and labelled with its review status. One small embedding model (BGE-small, int8) runs on your device only to rank existing claims by meaning; word matching is the fallback.
